courses.title: One-to-One Sessions with Bryan Kest
courses.description: Private online conversations with Bryan, booked by the session, in which he brings a yogic point of view and the practices and tools from his own decades of practice to whatever is going on in someone's life, from relationships and work to spirituality, purpose and physical setbacks. He describes them as a mix of mentoring, life coaching and support.
